pipeline.title: MAC Enrichment
pipeline.description: Normalize per-source MAC fields (cp_new_client_mac, aruba_client_mac, ...) into a unified `client_mac`, then resolve to a DHCP hostname via the infoblox-nios-mac lookup table. Mirrors the IPAM-enrichment pattern but for MAC addresses.

rules.title: mac normalize client_mac from cp_new_client_mac
rules.description: Cradlepoint client-connect events expose the MAC as cp_new_client_mac. Promote it to the unified client_mac field.
rules.source:
rule "mac normalize client_mac from cp_new_client_mac"
when
  has_field("cp_new_client_mac") &&
  !has_field("client_mac")
then
  set_field("client_mac", to_string($message.cp_new_client_mac));
end

rules.title: mac normalize client_mac from aruba_client_mac
rules.description: Aruba AP station events expose the MAC as aruba_client_mac. Promote to client_mac.
rules.source:
rule "mac normalize client_mac from aruba_client_mac"
when
  has_field("aruba_client_mac") &&
  !has_field("client_mac")
then
  set_field("client_mac", to_string($message.aruba_client_mac));
end

rules.title: mac enrich client_mac
rules.description: Resolve client_mac to its DHCP-assigned hostname via the infoblox-nios-mac lookup table (CSV synced hourly from NIOS fixedaddrs+leases by /usr/local/sbin/nios_mac_to_graylog_csv.py).
